Name: AT - Ib Paintings
Author: XKristal
Description:
[size=2][10/08/2025]: Hope you guys like this new and improved version of the mod, any recommendations and suggestions on what would you like me to do next are appreciated!

[09/08/2025]: I figure it out! Thanks to a comment and my own research, soon you will have a awesome version with the best looking paintings I could do, if I can, i will try doing some other thing and add them slowly. Thanks to all the dowloads!!

[08/08/2025]: Thanks to everyone who has dowloaded this mod so quickly!! I appreciate the comments and everything. First, tell you my native lenguage is spanish, so sorry if anything is a little weird written. Also I want to mention that I will be soon adding more paintings and trying to make them as less blurry as possible. If anyone has any recommendation on how to do so, don't forget to write it out in the comments! Have a great rest of your day![/size]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Install AlternativeTextures[/url]﻿.

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into "[font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]."
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][u]How to use:[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin.
[*]Use the Paint Bucket on the paintings listed in the image.
[/list]


Made with love for someone special to me, but anyone can use it!

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed the mod not telling in SMAPI that there's a update.

- All paintings have been added.
- Looks from the paintings have been fixed, no more weird bugs.
- Paintings look as good as I could possibly do.
